proof.text: For each degree, reindex the product Hom factors and use the ordinary Hom comparison from the tensor/Hom data. Product projections prove the signed differential and joint naturality. Transport quasi-isomorphisms and K-injective resolutions through the exact equivalence, then descend through the derived internal-Hom localization and the canonical `podReindexingHomModel`; this is strictly the derived portion of the parent theorem.
